sources.title: Jaisidh Singh
sources.snippet: I am a master's student at the University of Tübingen studying machine learning and a fellow at Zuse School ELIZA. I'm also a guest researcher at the Max Planck Institute for Intelligent Systems Tübingen advised by Antonio Orvieto. Currently, I'm writing my master's thesis on the scaling behaviour of LLMs with hybrid attention with . Previously, I was an intern at Bosch Research ...
